meta.name: version-dataset
meta.description: Dataset version control for research reproducibility. Builds a deterministic content-hash manifest of a dataset (file SHA-256 + tabular schema + per-column value hashes), verifies a later copy against it to detect drift (schema change, row-count change, value changes), and diffs two manifests. Use to prove an analysis ran on the intended data, lock a dataset version, or reproducibility-lock bundled demos.
